cards.consumerAndFactSource: Life.step/stepEntity consume existing World facts; C2 gates skill maintenance and B2 calls nearestSeekSite only in the existing planNext roll<0.42 branch.
cards.settlementObjects: Life traverses the same entity list. Skill maintenance is eligible for level>0, existing combat, or explicit skills. Each seek query scans current world.sites once.
cards.timePrecision: One Life.step call per existing advance; optional dt bucket records that call's dtDays; eligibility is checked at the existing per-entity point.
cards.worstCaseCost: The outer Life entity traversal is O(N), but inherited transitive effect scans can cost O(readEffects calls * N) plus other subsystem work. C2 eligibility is O(1); B2 is one O(S) sites pass with inclusive radius-30 checks and prospective cave content validation. No sorting, candidate array, or index. Life timers remain nested: stepEntity within entity-loop; advance life wraps Life.step.
cards.queryMethod: Existing Life entity array and direct profile fields; diagnostics use direct counters only.
cards.rngContract: C2 eligibility draws no RNG. B2 keeps the old roll<0.42 branch. Previously, a nearest formation prevented seek; a nearest empty cave still allowed seek to that empty cave. B2 skips both and may choose a farther viable target or fall through, changing destination and potentially later Life.rng trajectory. Not baseline RNG-equivalent.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache. Eligibility reads current profile; site search reads current positions, kind/content, and artifact ownership.
cards.dataLifetime: No new search save fields. C2 may omit default empty skills/combat for unqualified profiles; B2 stores its chosen destination through existing plan state.
cards.failureAndExit: Candidate is not a route reachability proof; planNext does no pathfinding. Existing stale-target/arrival behavior remains.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled C2 eligibility/save fixtures and same-version metrics equivalence. B2 controlled Life.planNext fixture covers excluded empty cave/formation, selected valid nearby site and draw boundary. 100-year A/B passed per implementation report; 400-year pending separately.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: advanceWorld reads World and invokes existing simulation phase entry points; S-only diagnostics wrap the existing Life.step call.
cards.settlementObjects: Same configured Life instance and current world phases; diagnostics add no populations or phase calls.
cards.timePrecision: Requested simulation advancement and existing phase boundaries.
cards.worstCaseCost: Disabled path checks metrics opt-in once before Life timing. Enabled life wall time wraps the whole Life.step call and therefore includes prepare, entity-loop, and post-entity timers; never sum these inclusive totals as disjoint costs.
cards.queryMethod: Existing subsystem entry points; metrics use direct WeakMap lookup.
cards.rngContract: Life timing adds no RNG; phase order, stream ownership and ordering unchanged.
cards.dataLifetime: World metrics remain opt-in WeakMap state, excluded from saves.
cards.failureAndExit: Existing skip/stop behavior preserved; if Life.step throws, no post-step total is recorded by existing control flow.
cards.testEvidence: Enabled/disabled complete world and all registered RNG digest equal on a 30-day paired run; separate 100/400-year diagnostics runs are reported as measurement evidence.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: stepSkillResources reads/updates existing Wanxiang practice/combat/resource state. Optional world argument only enables diagnostics. C1 updateCombatResources does default-skill setup, one capacity read, allocation/clamp, then regeneration. C2 needsSkillResources is a pure O(1) predicate over level, existing combat, and explicit skill slots.
cards.settlementObjects: Life calls maintenance only for profiles with level>0, existing combat state, or a non-empty explicit skill list. Direct stepSkillResources calls repeat the predicate guard; retained legacy state remains eligible.
cards.timePrecision: Existing entity step; no new invocation or scheduling.
cards.worstCaseCost: Eligible update retains bounded per-entity practice/effect/resource work; C1 performs one manaCapacity evaluation. B gate is O(1), and rejected profiles avoid practiceState/default skills/combat allocation and regeneration. Metrics are opt-in O(1). Capacity counter is only for stepSkillResources/combatState calls receiving world, not all global capacity calls.
cards.queryMethod: Direct entity reference and current cultivation/practice fields.
cards.rngContract: The third world argument enables diagnostics only. Predicate, C1 capacity dedup, and resource maintenance draw no RNG. C2 changes whether default empty combat state is created for an unqualified profile; future content granting mana/devour/other resource semantics to level-zero entities must extend eligibility before relying on this maintenance path.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; predicate and capacity read current level/skills/combat/physique every call.
cards.dataLifetime: Existing combat/skills save payload is preserved when present. C2 stops creating default skill/combat fields for ineligible profiles; save shape therefore intentionally differs from baseline for those profiles, with no schema/version change.
cards.failureAndExit: Invalid/nonpositive dt exits as before. A zero-level entity with combat or explicit skills remains maintained; injury, possession, identity/plane, or level loss do not erase retained state. A zero-level profile with none of these is skipped.
cards.testEvidence: C1 --capacity-only asserts one capacity read per eligible update. C2 controlled tests cover empty mortals 30/360 days, legacy combat, explicit skills, formal awakening, identity/injury/plane, death cleanup, and v11 restore. Same-version metrics on/off equivalence passes. Original-baseline B replay is not asserted bitwise; output may differ by omitted default payload and future world-line consequences.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: Opt-in WeakMap metrics observe existing simulation calls; they never write World facts.
cards.settlementObjects: Only explicitly enabled World instance and supplied scalar labels/counts.
cards.timePrecision: At existing instrumented call boundaries; Life dtDays use eight fixed buckets plus count/sum/min/max.
cards.worstCaseCost: Disabled consumers do one opt-in check where needed and perform no performance.now call or metrics bucket allocation. Enabled updates are O(1) per instrumented call, no entity enumeration; snapshots clone accumulated bounded metric records.
cards.queryMethod: WeakMap lookup by World object and WeakSet actor deduplication without retaining dead actors; snapshots copy fixed-key metric records.
cards.cacheInvalidation: WeakMap ownership follows World lifetime; explicit disable/reset clears measurement state.
cards.dataLifetime: Diagnostic-only ephemeral memory; excluded from save/profile/runtime world state. Histogram keys are fixed.
cards.failureAndExit: Timing API uses performance.now directly on enabled timing paths; no missing-clock fallback is implemented.
cards.testEvidence: Enabled/disabled complete-world/RNG digest equality for 30-day paired runs; metrics script checks opt-in off by default, fixed buckets and snapshot isolation. Separate 100/400-year paired measurements provide duration evidence.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: readEffects reads current entity/world facts and returns a derived effect view.
cards.settlementObjects: One requested entity plus transitive peer/shared entity scans in conditions and experiences.
cards.timePrecision: Caller query; existing callers determine frequency.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(readEffects calls * N) aggregate work where peer/shared scans occur; each such scan may visit up to N entities. The inherited card does not have a one-entity bound.
cards.queryMethod: Direct entity reference plus existing ID/local lookups.
cards.rngContract: Pure read; no RNG draw or stream mutation.
cards.cacheInvalidation: Do not cache complete dynamic output without invalidating every condition, target, position, relation, and injury dependency.
cards.dataLifetime: Derived result is transient; no save changes.
cards.failureAndExit: Missing/dead/unavailable target follows existing effect semantics and returns safely.
cards.testEvidence: WX-E1 synthetic N fixtures enforce scan budgets; natural-world measurement is reported separately; purity/RNG and effect call counts remain required.

cards.settlementObjects: Existing visible/runtime world; no additional all-world consumer permitted.
cards.timePrecision: Frame/rAF update; new simulation consumers are prohibited here unless a bounded explicit exception is approved.
cards.worstCaseCost: Inherited baseline; any exception must give strict per-frame object and time bounds.
cards.queryMethod: Existing frame-local references and render indexes.
cards.rngContract: Rendering/observation adds no simulation RNG draws.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No new cross-frame cache without explicit complete invalidation.
cards.dataLifetime: Transient runtime state; no new save fields.
cards.failureAndExit: Pause, teardown, world replacement, and hidden/inactive view stop optional work.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled frame-call assertions, no extra simulation changes, and measured bounded work.

cards.riskClass: B: changes target selection by skipping a nearest formation or empty cave; this can change seek/fallback decisions and subsequent Life.rng trajectory.
cards.consumerAndFactSource: Implemented nearestSeekSite, called only from the existing planNext roll<0.42 branch. Reads world.sites and uses siteHasContent for prospective caves; arrival/rewards remain existing consumers.
cards.settlementObjects: One planning actor; one traversal of world.sites. Excludes formations and caves with siteHasContent=false. Secret realms, ruins and other kinds remain eligible for generic rewards. No extra actor-level or route qualification.
cards.timePrecision: Only when planNext reselects a destination; not every frame or simulation step.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(S) scan plus siteHasContent checks for prospective cave candidates within the current radius-30 best set; content validation may inspect artifact ownership. No hard candidate cap, history scan, persistent index, sort, or candidate array. Metrics-off path does not time or allocate candidates. Metrics-on nearest-* diagnostics perform one extra read-only check of raw nearest; this may be a dormant cave and does not describe the selected target.
cards.queryMethod: Single pass over world.sites with squared-distance radius/pre-pruning; sqrt only as needed. Exact ties keep array order, matching the previous stable sitesNear sort. No spatial index.
cards.rngContract: Selector consumes no RNG; existing roll<0.42 remains. Previously a nearest formation prevented seek, while a nearest empty cave still produced a seek toward that cave. B2 skips both: it may select a farther viable site or return no target, changing destination/fallback and potentially later Life.rng trajectory. The controlled duration draw result is only for that fixture.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; every call reads current site position/content and artifact ownership.
cards.dataLifetime: No new persistent search state; existing plan state retains selected destination.
cards.failureAndExit: Inclusive radius 30. Candidate does not prove reachability; current planning does not pathfind. No new cancellation protocol.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled tests cover empty/content cave, secret/ruin generic rewards, radius, stable array-order ties, fresh content after claim/exhaustion, and Life.planNext draw boundary. 100-year A/B passed per implementation report; 400-year A/B passed per parent follow-up. seek.checked counts all sites; content-checks only prospective candidates; nearest-* describes raw nearest and includes its extra read-only diagnostic check.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: Existing sim/sites.js reads and updates world.sites, artifact ownership/content and formal site outcomes; S-only metrics count lifecycle checks and committed site outcome points.
cards.settlementObjects: The existing full world.sites array for lifecycle traversal; attempted outcome counters only when enterSite passes existing level eligibility; arrival-attempts includes formal arrival calls that may repeat study attempts.
cards.timePrecision: Existing site lifecycle and enterSite/committed outcome points.
cards.worstCaseCost: Existing traversal/search cost is unchanged; metric increments are O(1) at existing points, with no new scan. arrival-attempts is not a unique-arrivals count.
cards.queryMethod: Existing world.sites array and current nearby/content checks; metrics create no index.
cards.rngContract: Counters add no RNG draws and do not affect site creation/expiry/reward decisions.
cards.dataLifetime: Diagnostic counters are opt-in ephemeral metrics; no save/schema change.
cards.failureAndExit: Existing early exits, repeated study attempts, site expiry/removal and encounter behavior remain unchanged; only reached metric points count.
cards.testEvidence: Metrics on/off complete-world/RNG equality plus formal counter-site outcomes under existing enterSite path; lifecycle examined counts reflect the pre-existing full sites traversal.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: shared_insight reads current plane/id targets during the audited native Life entity loop.
cards.settlementObjects: One caller and bounded active bond targets; a lazy identity Map derives from the current world.entities array.
cards.timePrecision: Every original effect read, with current hp/coordinates. Scope begins after spawn/grid preparation and ends before death compaction in finally.
cards.worstCaseCost: One O(N) build per queried native entity loop; O(B) target lookups where B is active bonds. Invalid identity or unowned queries retain original O(N*B) find. All build/candidate/fallback visits counted.
cards.queryMethod: Strict canonical plane:id -> current object/index; multiple targets retain world order; no persistent population Map.
cards.rngContract: No RNG draw or gameplay state write.
cards.cacheInvalidation: World add/remove invalidates. Array identity/length/plane and resolved tuple checked. Stock Life method identity required; unowned/manual/upper/nether and inter-pass direct mutations scan/rebuild safely. No arbitrary in-loop external mutation contract.
cards.dataLifetime: WeakMap only during synchronous native entity loop; finally deletes references, no save fields.
cards.failureAndExit: Malformed/duplicate IDs, repeated refs, sparse data, noncanonical/duplicate target keys and invalidated passes use original find; original invalid-input rejection retained.
cards.testEvidence: 37 controlled cases/222 queries; native972712 Object.is queries/16537224 axes zero mismatch, full world/all RNG/sourceTags/v11 forks at both ages/dts. Actual fallback and unknown-work red fixture paths fail budget.
